microsoft-1970393557078629.text: Lead cross-functional teams to land monetization strategy, pricing decisions, and packaging constructs for your product areas: Collaborate with product engineering and product marketing on product vision, offer strategy and packaging constructs Partner with finance to determine the revenue and customer lifetime value impact of business model decisions Conduct market research to understand total addressable market, competitive dynamics, optimal customer segmentation, and customer willingness to pay Engage with our Operations & Business Insights team to optimize pricing and launch products across hundreds of regions worldwide Partner with the New Commerce and Commercial Strategy team to develop and land new business models with commerce engineering and sales organizations Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Computer Science, Economics, Business, or related field AND 4+ years product management, strategy consulting, finance, business/corporate development, or related experience Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Computer Science, Economics, Business, or related field AND 8+ years product management, strategy consulting, finance, business/corporate development, or related experience OR Master's Degree in Business Administration (MBA), or related field AND 6+ years product management, strategy consulting, finance, business/corporate development, or related experience OR equivalent experience. Effective communicator who can adapt your style and message across various stakeholders and levels, including marketing and engineering executives, customers, and partners. Strategic framing skills to create alignment between engineering, product marketing, and business owners. Efficient problem-solver who can see the big picture and possess deep analytical skills, including the ability to synthesize data from multiple sources to make data-driven decisions. Consistently deliver results and demonstrate good judgment, personal accountability, and high integrity. Ability to work independently and effectively as part of a broad team, and drive successful outcomes with virtual teams.
